description: Source code for the class AndroidXmlTagDescriptor, which implements XML element descriptor and PSI metadata for Android XML tags within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment.

classes.name: AndroidXmlTagDescriptor
classes.description: Implements XML element descriptor and PSI metadata for Android XML tags, providing tag and attribute descriptions, icon support, and class-based content type determination.

methods.name: getQualifiedName
methods.description: Returns the qualified name of the parent descriptor.

methods.name: getDefaultName
methods.description: Returns the default name from the parent descriptor.

methods.name: getElementsDescriptors
methods.description: Retrieves descriptors for child elements, potentially wrapping them with additional class-based descriptors if a base class name is specified.

methods.name: getElementDescriptor
methods.description: Gets the descriptor for a specific child tag, or a generic descriptor if none is found.

methods.name: getAttributesDescriptors
methods.description: Returns attribute descriptors, reordering 'layout_width' and 'layout_height' if both are present.

methods.name: getAttributeDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves a descriptor for a specific attribute by name.

methods.name: getAttributeDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves a descriptor for a specific attribute by XmlAttribute object.

methods.name: getNSDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the namespace descriptor from the parent descriptor.

methods.name: getTopGroup
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no top group.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Determines content type based on the associated declaration class, checking inheritance from View and ViewGroup classes.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no default value.

methods.name: getDeclaration
methods.description: Returns the declaration PsiElement, typically the associated class.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the descriptor with a PsiElement.

methods.name: getDependences
methods.description: Returns dependencies from the parent descriptor.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no specific type name.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with this descriptor.
